gloss: royal fern; fiddlehead of the royal fern (edible wild plant)

definitions.gloss: royal fern; its coiled young shoots eaten as a wild vegetable
definitions.explanation: A fern whose tightly curled spring shoots are gathered as {山菜|さんさい} (wild mountain vegetables). The shoots must be boiled and soaked before eating, and are often sold dried.

examples.japanese: ぜんまい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。

examples.english: When spring comes, we gather royal fern in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{干|ほ}した→干す：00115_hosu⟧ぜんまい⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}して→戻す：02317_modosu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Dried royal fern is delicious if you rehydrate it in water and then stir-fry it in oil.

notes:
Usually written in kana; the kanji {薇|ぜんまい} is rare. One of the classic ⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧ of early spring, along with ⟦{蕨|わらび}→蕨：30491_warabi⟧ and ⟦ふきのとう→ふきのとう：30496_fukinotou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぜんまい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered royal fern
- ぜんまい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採|と}る→採る：20862_toru⟧: to gather royal fern
- ⟦{干|ほ}し→干す：00115_hosu⟧ぜんまい: dried royal fern
- ぜんまい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ナムル→ナムル：16310_namuru⟧: royal fern namul (a common Korean-style side dish)

HOMONYM:
The same-sounding ぜんまい also means a coiled spring or clockwork mechanism (ぜんまい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧, to wind up a spring) — the plant's tight spiral is the source of that sense.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蕨|わらび}→蕨：30491_warabi⟧: bracken — another spring fern shoot, thinner and used for {蕨餅|わらびもち} starch
- ⟦ふきのとう→ふきのとう：30496_fukinotou⟧: butterbur bud — bitter, and eaten as tempura or miso rather than simmered
